docTitle: Di Bible thru Map · Di Bible for One Look
metaDesc: Follow di Old Testament timeline, di life of Jesus, and Paul journeys for one real map — di Bible happen for real places.

s.kicker: Di Bible for One Look · Maps
s.title: Di Bible thru Map
s.verse: “Bikos, wi nor use awa brain take tell una lie-lie story about Christ pawa and how E go kom back.” (2 Peter 1:16)
s.purpose: Di Bible nor bi myth. Na record of pipol wey waka for real places, real dates, and real names. Follow doz paths for map, for di way dem take happen — tosh one point, or press ▶ make yu waka thru am step by step.
s.ot_kick: ① Old Testament — thru di time
s.ot_h: From creation rish di return go Jerusalem
s.ot_lead: Nor bi just one trip, but na di flow of di redemptive history from creation kon go front: creation and di fall → flood and Babel → one koll (Abraham) → di promise land → Exodus → wildaness → konkwest → kingdom → division → exile → return.
s.je_kick: ② New Testament — di life of Jesus
s.je_lead: Follow di life of Jesus as di Good News buks take tell am, for order — from en birt for Betlehem, thru en baptism and en work for Galilee, across Samaria, rish di cross, resurreshon and to go up for Jerusalem.
s.pa_h: From Antiok rish di end of di eart — Rome
s.pa_lead: From Pentecost for Jerusalem, how di Good News spread pass Judea — thru Asia Minor and Europe rish di heart of di empire. Pik one of di five journeys (1st·2nd·3rd + di voyage go Rome + afta dem release am) and follow di tins wey happen for Acts with di letas wey dem rite for di road.
s.foot: Sources · Di places follow di Bible text and di standard Bible geografi (with modern names where e go helep). Di koastlines, rivas and lakes komot from open geografik data (Natural Earth), wey dem make simple.

eden.name: Eden (Creation · Di Fall)
eden.note: Into one world wey God make «good well-well», sin enter kon break di bond between God and man.
events: Creation for six days — «e good well-well»
Man dem make for di image of God
Di fall, and dem drive dem komot Eden
Di first promise of di Good News — «di pikin wey woman born go mash di snake head»

noah.name: Ararat (Di Flood)
noah.note: God judge one world wey full of sin, but E keep life alive thru one family.
events: One world wey full of korrupshon
Di flood, and Noah ark
Di rainbow kovenant — «flood nor go ever distroy di eart again»

babel.name: Di Tower of Babel
babel.note: Against di pride wey wan rish heaven, God skata dia langwej and skata di pipol for di whole eart.
events: «Make wi build one city and one tower… make wi make name for awasef»
God konfuse dia langwej
Di pipol skata for di whole eart (Shinar — wey turn Babilon afta)

ur.name: Ur
ur.note: Di Bible story of redemption start with di koll of one man.
events: God koll Abram komot from Ur of di Kaldeans
«I go turn yu to one strong kountry… all di pipol go get blessing thru yu»
By faith e komot from en own land

haran.name: Haran
haran.note: For di road, dey answa di koll wey point go di promise land.
events: Terah family settle for Haran
Terah die
Abram komot go Kanaan wen e bi 75 years old

shechem.name: Shekem · Kanaan
shechem.note: For di promise land dem start one family and di kovenant pass down thru di generashons.
events: Enter Kanaan, di first altar — «I go give dis land to yor pikin dem»
Di kovenant (Jen 15) · Isaac · Jacob
Jacob twelve sons — di root of di twelve tribes

egypt.name: Egypt (Goshen)
egypt.note: One family turn to one big kountry — den turn to kountry of slave.
events: Joseph, wey dem sell, rise go rule Egypt
Jacob whole family kom down to run from hunger
Di Israel wey dey grow turn to slave

sinai.name: Mount Sinai
sinai.note: Di senter rescue of di OT — slave dem turn to God own pipol.
events: Di ten plagues and di Passover lamb
Di Red Sea open and dem kross
Di Ten Komandments, di Law, di tent of God and di sakrifice

kadesh.name: Kadesh (wildaness)
kadesh.note: Bikos dem nor bilive, one generashon lose di land — but God still dey with dem.
events: Twelve spies — but di pipol refuse to trust God
38 years for di wildaness — manna, cloud and fire
For di plains of Moab, Moses last sermon (Deutronomi)

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: For di end dem enter kon take di promise land.
events: Di Jordan open and di pipol kross
Di walls of Jericho fall
Konkwest of Kanaan and division of di land

shiloh.name: Shailo (Judges)
shiloh.note: With no king, evribody dey do wetin good for en eye — dem need one true king.
events: Dem set up di tent of God for Shailo
Di round-and-round of sin–presing–rescue (Debora, Gideon, Samson)
Rut — faithfulness for dark days, for David line

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem · Di United Kingdom
jerusalem.note: Israel golden time — and di promise of one king wey go last forever.
events: Saul di first king, den David and Goliat
Di kovenant with David — «yor throne go stand forever» (2 Sam 7)
Solomon build di temple for Jerusalem

samaria.name: Samaria · Di Divided Kingdom
samaria.note: Di kingdom split kon dey go down as di profets dey kry out.
events: Afta Solomon, e split into Judah and Israel
Idol worship wey dey repeat
Elijah, Isaya, Jeremaya dey kry «kom back» — and dey tok about di Messiah wey go kom

nineveh.name: Nineveh (Assiria)
nineveh.note: As dem ignore evri warning, na di nort fall first.
events: Nineveh, di kapital of Assiria
Di nort kingdom fall to Assiria (722 BC)
Dem send Jona go Nineveh

babylon.name: Babilon
babylon.note: Di darkest night — but di promise of restoration still dey.
events: Jerusalem fall, dem burn di temple (586 BC)
Dem karry Judah go Babilon
Daniel and Ezekiel — faith and vision for di exile

susa.name: Susa (Persia)
susa.note: Even for di heart of one pagan empire, God dey keep en pipol.
events: Persia overtrow Babilon
Esther save di Jews from being wipe komot
Nehemaya pray before di king kon dem send am

return.name: Return go Jerusalem
return.note: Dem kom back kon rebuild — but no king don kom. Dem dey wait for di Messiah.
events: Three waves of return thru Cyrus order (Zerubbabel 538 · Ezra 458 · Nehemaya 444)
Dem rebuild di temple and repair di Jerusalem walls
Malakai — di OT klose: «I dey send my messenja»

bethlehem.name: Betlehem
bethlehem.note: Di promise Messiah kom to di town of David — di Word wey turn to pesin.
events: Dem born am for Betlehem, di town of David
Angels announce di news to shepherds
Di wise men kom to worship am

nazareth.name: Nazaret
nazareth.note: God grow up as man for one ordinary town.
events: Dem raise am for karpenta house
For twelve years, e dey ask and answa for di temple
Afta, dem rejet am for en own town sinagog

jordan.name: Jordan River
jordan.note: En publik work start — heaven mark am as di Son.
events: John baptize am
Di Spirit kom down like dove — «Dis na my Pikin wey I love»
E win Satan three temptashons for di wildaness

cana.name: Kana
cana.note: For en first sign, E show en glory.
events: One guest for one wedding
Water turn to wine — en first sign
En disciples bilive for am

sychar.name: Sychar (Samaria)
sychar.note: Di early work road — thru Jerusalem kon go di Samaria wey dem despise.
events: E klean di temple for Jerusalem
For night, Nicodemus — «yu must to born again»
Living water for one Samaria woman

capernaum.name: Kapernaum
capernaum.note: Home base of di Galilee work — koll, teachin and opposition all meet here.
events: E koll di fishermen kon base ensef here
Di Sermon on di Mount — «Blessing dey for doz wey poor for spirit»
Parables of di kingdom — and opposition wey dey grow

galilee.name: Sea of Galilee
galilee.note: With pawa ova nechure, E show who E bi.
events: «Peace, be kwaiet» — E kalm di storm
E feed 5,000 with five bread and two fish
E waka on top di water

caesarea_p.name: Kaisaria Filipai
caesarea_p.note: Di disciples undastand sey E na di Christ, and di road of di cross open.
events: Peter konfesshon — «Yu na di Christ, di Pikin of di living God»
E first tok about en deat and resurreshon
E shange for glory on top di mountin

jericho.name: Jericho
jericho.note: For di road wey dey go up Jerusalem, E dey find doz wey lost.
events: E give blind Bartimaeus en eye back
E koll Zacchaeus di tax kollekta
«Di Son of Man kom find and save doz wey don lost»

bethany.name: Betani
bethany.note: E show pawa ova deat for di eve of en last week.
events: E raise Lazarus from di grave — «Na mi bi di resurreshon and di life»
Mary rub oil on am for en burial
Dis sign make di plan to kill am hard pass

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: Di top-point wey di whole Bible dey point go — cross, resurreshon, to go up.
events: E enter with triumph; E ton di temple tables again
For di Last Supper E wash di disciples feet
E die for di cross
E rise for di third day, den E go up

antioch.name: Antiok
antioch.note: Di sending church where di gentile mission start and dey return.
events: For prayer, di Spirit set apart Barnabas and Saul
Di church where dem first koll di bilivas «Christians»
Di start-point of di 1st, 2nd and 3rd journeys

seleucia.name: Seleucia
seleucia.note: Antiok port — dem set sail go Cyprus.

salamis.name: Salamis (Cyprus)
salamis.note: Di first stop for Cyprus — dem preach for di sinagogs.

paphos.name: Paphos
paphos.note: Dem show pawa against doz wey stand against di Good News.
events: Elymas di magishan turn blind
Sergius Paulus di gova bilive
From here, na «Paul» dey lead

perga.name: Perga
perga.note: One port for Pamphylia — na here John Mark turn back.

pantioch.name: Pisidia Antiok
pantioch.note: Di Good News break open go di gentiles.
events: One long sermon of salvation history for di sinagog
Plenty gentiles rejoice kon receive di word
Opposition drive dem komot

iconium.name: Iconium
iconium.note: Plenty bilive, but persecution push dem go front.

lystra.name: Lystra
lystra.note: Dem hail am as god, den dem stone am.
events: E heal one man wey bi lame from birt
Di crowd try to sakrifice to dem as gods
Dem stone am kon lef am as dead, but e stand up

derbe.name: Derbe
derbe.note: Dem make plenty disciples; dem waka back to make di churches strong.

troas.name: Troas
troas.note: Di turnin-point where di Good News first head go Europe.
events: One vision of one man of Macedonia
«Kom ova, kom helep us»
Dem kross go Europe wantwant

philippi.name: Filipai
philippi.note: Europe first church — di Good News win even for prison.
events: Lydia, one woman wey dey sell purple klot, bilive
Dem free one slave girl wey dey tell fortune
Midnight songs, one eart-shake, di prison-keeper family save

thess.name: Tesalonika
thess.note: Di word shake di city kon di opposition boil ova.
events: E reason for di sinagog three Sabbaths
«Dis pipol wey don ton di world upside down»
Dem komot for night

berea.name: Berea
berea.note: Di «noble» ones wey check di word for demsef.
events: Dem receive di word with eagerness
Evriday dem check di Skriptures to konfirm am
Plenty kom bilive

athens.name: Atens
athens.note: For di city of filosofas, E announce di «unknown god».
events: Di city full of idols vex am
For di Areopagus E preach di Creator and di resurreshon
Dem laf am, but small pipol bilive

corinth.name: Korint
corinth.note: E stay one year and half, dey plant church for one city wey full of bad tin.
events: E make tents with Aquila and Priscilla
«Nor fear… bikos I dey with yu»
Plenty Korint pipol bilive kon dem baptize dem

ephesus.name: Efesus
ephesus.note: Heart of di third journey — di word spread across Asia.
events: E teach evriday for two years for di hall of Tyrannus
Dem burn magik buks; pawaful works
Demetrius di silversmith start one riot

miletus.name: Miletus
miletus.note: One farewell with tears to di Efesus elders.
events: «Take kare of di church wey E buy with en own blood»
Di elders kry, sabi sey dem nor go si am again

caesarea.name: Kaisaria
caesarea.note: For two years E defend di Good News before govas and one king.
events: Trials before di govas Felix and Festus
En defens before King Agrippa
«I appeal to Caesar» — go Rome

jerusalem.name: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: Dem grab am for di temple, and en road as prisoner start.
events: Di crowd grab am for di temple
E defend ensef before di kounsil
As Roman sitizen, dem send am unda guard go Kaisaria

myra.name: Myra
myra.note: Dem shange go one Alexandria ship wey dey go Rome.

fairhaven.name: Fair Havens (Crete)
fairhaven.note: Dem nor gri Paul warning to stop di sailing.

crete.name: Crete
crete.note: Afta dem release am, di island where E lef Titus to set di churches in order.
events: E lef Titus to appoint elders for evri town
E ask for leaders wey nor get blame, wey faithful
E rite di leta to Titus

malta.name: Malta
malta.note: Thru storm and shipwreck, God promise stand.
events: Di «northeaster» wreck di ship, but all 276 survive
One snake bite am, but notin happen to am
E heal di sik pipol of di island

syracuse.name: Syracuse
syracuse.note: Dem stay three days for Sicily.

puteoli.name: Puteoli
puteoli.note: Dem land for Italy kon di fellow bilivas meet dem.

rome.name: Rome
rome.note: Di Good News rish di heart of di empire for di end — nor bi one end but na one beginning.
events: Two years unda house arrest, dey boldly announce di kingdom
From here E rite di Prison Letas (Efe·Fil·Kol·Fmn)
Afta, dem lock am again, E rite 2 Timoti kon dem kill am — «I don fight di good fight, I don finish di race»

journeys.j5: Fift journey · afta dem release am
